signature: A mid-century medical research clinic of seven rooms off one linoleum corridor, ending five steps down at a machine of undetermined composition whose sixteen clocks all disagree, which sobs electrically and, every so often, knocks.

exits.to_label: Not stated (the log suggests displacement in time)
exits.label: Opened the door at the start of the main corridor
exits.source_quote: only one known entrance and exit located at the beginning of the main corridor
exits.hint: The way in is the only way out. Where, and when, it opens is not stated.

entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE. The page names none (its warning says only 'Unknown Potential for Entities'); the title's 'ghosts' are not spawned. The machine is not a creature or a boss: it sobs, ticks, knocks and leaks.
notes: SOURCE: seven rooms of intelligent design off one main corridor, alternating right/left with the seventh central at the end; about 370 m2; mid-20th-century medical research clinic with signs of occupation. Room contents follow the page tab by tab: 1 office (fire-damaged desk, filing cabinets and shelving haphazard in a storage closet; Dr. Zohn's yellow-chalk note on a large black chalkboard, quoted, 22 words), 2 equipment storage (cardiopulmonary monitor, dialysis machine, sonograph, ECG, ventilator, fixed-angle centrifuge, four advanced machines of unknown purpose), 3 examination (wall-embedded machine on the right with corrugated hoses, IV lines and wires; locked medicine cabinet on the left: Almond Water, pethidine, azathioprine, LSD, doxorubicin, Seer powder, scopolamine, melatonin lollipops), 4 X-ray (mid-century unit, negatoscope with one film of a child's deformed arm), 5 living quarters (six twin mattresses on wire frames, two dressers: grey youth-small clothes, red handball, three black crayons, 14 blank sheets), 6 operating theatre (empty; slurry of viscera and fluids with screws and metal shavings), 7 the machine (16 clocks each a different time; electrically distorted sobbing and a knock/tremor/no-clip sensation about every 30 minutes, both TESTIMONY; slow leak from its left side). One entrance/exit at the start of the corridor; inconsistent exit; submission log dates. ADAPTATION: exact floor plan and dimensions (corridor 24 x 2.8 m, rooms 30-48 m2, machine hall 11 x 10 m), the theatre sunk 0.72 m below a viewing landing and the machine hall 0.9 m below the corridor (natural vertical variation; the page gives none); lighting is not stated, so most fixtures are dead, a few weak ones remain, plus the lit negatoscope and the faintly lit clock faces; one machine cycle per ~150 s of play instead of 30 min; the corridor clock jumps at each knock and the leak spreads over time; equipment is assembled from generic carts and CC0 models (the four unknown machines use Kenney space-kit machines); the exit's destination is not stated (EXT release boundary) and the date mismatch is only reported as text. No Level 78 edge (link list only).
